topics.purpose: Ask one direction-level research question about the SerSplit edge-defect route.
topics.question: The standard genetic code is within three Hamming-1 synonymous edges of the size-profile maximum, and the whole deficit is concentrated in Stop and Ser. Ignore local pipeline details. Focus only on the sense-side Ser split: Ser has a UCN four-codon component and an AGY two-codon component with no Hamming-1 bridge between them. What is the strongest biological mechanism by which this Ser split edge-defect could align with a real expression- or translation-level codon-selection pressure that is not reducible to tRNA supply, wobble, GC, codon-pair bias, mRNA stability, or ribosome dwell? Give the mechanistic route, the decisive confounders, and the next single question that should be asked if this route survives.
